summary: Build foundational knowledge of ISO 45001 clauses 4–10 and prepare for the PECB Foundation exam in a two-day course.
audienceIntro: ISO 45001 Foundation is designed for people who need an introductory grounding in OH&S management and the requirements of an OH&S MS. It can help you connect your workplace health and safety responsibilities with the standard’s core topics.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course. To apply for the PECB Certificate Holder in ISO 45001 Foundation credential, you must pass the PECB ISO 45001 Foundation exam and sign the PECB Code of Ethics. PECB lists no professional experience, management-system audit or assessment experience, or OH&S MS project experience requirement for this credential.
